arxiv-2103-02729.title: Linear Bandit Algorithms with Sublinear Time Complexity
arxiv-2103-02729.creator: Shuo Yang, Tongzheng Ren, Sanjay Shakkottai, Eric Price, Inderjit S. Dhillon, Sujay Sanghavi
arxiv-2103-02729.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shuo Yang, Tongzheng Ren, Sanjay Shakkottai, Eric Price, Inderjit S. Dhillon, Sujay Sanghavi. We propose two linear bandits algorithms with per-step complexity sublinear in the number of arms K K . The algorithms are designed for applications where the arm set is extremely large and slowly changing. Our key realization is that choosing an arm reduces to a maximum inner product search (MIPS) problem, which can be solved approximately without breaking regret guarantees. Existing approximate MIPS solvers run in sublinear time.

arxiv-2105-02477.title: Quantitative Evaluation of Alternative Translations in a Corpus of Highly Dissimilar Finnish Paraphrases
arxiv-2105-02477.creator: Li-Hsin Chang, Sampo Pyysalo, Jenna Kanerva, Filip Ginter
arxiv-2105-02477.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a quantitative evaluation of differences between alternative translations in a large recently released Finnish paraphrase corpus focusing in particular on non-trivial variation in translation. We combine a series of automatic steps detecting systematic variation with manual analysis to reveal regularities and identify categories of translation differences.

arxiv-2105-13282.title: Detection of a rank-one signal with limited training data Journal: Signal Processing
arxiv-2105-13282.creator: Weijian Liu a , Zhaojian Zhang a , Jun Liu b, , Zheran Shang c , Yong-Liang Wang a
arxiv-2105-13282.description: Abstract In this paper, we reconsider the problem of detecting a matrix-valued rank-one signal in unknown Gaussian noise, which was previously addressed for the case of sufficient training data. We relax the above assumption to the case of limited training data.

arxiv-2205-08586.title: Treatment Choice with Nonlinear Regret Thanks: We would like to thank Isaiah Andrews, Tommaso Denti, Takashi Hayashi, Keisuke Hirano, Charles Manski, Francesca Molinari, José Luis Montiel Olea, Collin Raymond, Jörg Stoye, Aleksey Tetenov, Davide Viviano, Kohei Yata, and the participants at ASSA 2023
arxiv-2205-08586.creator: Toru Kitagawa, Sokbae Lee, Chen Qiu
arxiv-2205-08586.description: Abstract The literature focuses on the mean of welfare regret, which can lead to undesirable treatment choice due to sensitivity to sampling uncertainty. We propose to minimize the mean of a nonlinear transformation of regret and show that singleton rules are not essentially complete for nonlinear regret.

arxiv-2307-05069.title: Cognitive Bias and Belief Revision
arxiv-2307-05069.creator: Panagiotis Papadamos, Nina Gierasimczuk
arxiv-2307-05069.description: Abstract In this paper we formalise three types of cognitive bias within the framework of belief revision: confirmation bias, framing bias, and anchoring bias. We interpret them generally, as restrictions on the process of iterated revision, and we apply them to three well-known belief revision methods: conditioning, lexicographic revision, and minimal revision.

arxiv-2412-10174.title: Beam test results of a fully 3D-printed plastic scintillator particle detector prototype Journal: JINST
arxiv-2412-10174.creator: Botao Li, Tim Weber, Umut Kose, Matthew Franks, Johannes Wüthrich, Xingyu Zhao, Davide Sgalaberna, Andrey Boyarintsev, Tetiana Sibilieva, Siddartha Berns, Eric Boillat, Albert De Roeck, Till Dieminger, Boris Grynyov, Sylvain Hugon, Carsten Jaeschke, André Rubbia

arxiv-2502-12992.title: B-cos LM: Efficiently Transforming Pre-trained Language Models for Improved Explainability
arxiv-2502-12992.creator: Yifan Wang, Sukrut Rao, Ji-Ung Lee, Mayank Jobanputra, Vera Demberg
arxiv-2502-12992.description: Abstract Post-hoc explanation methods for black-box models often struggle with faithfulness and human interpretability due to the lack of explainability in current neural models. Meanwhile, B-cos networks have been introduced to improve model explainability through architectural and computational adaptations, but their application has so far been limited to computer vision models and their associated training pipelines.

arxiv-2502-16071.title: Improving Deep Assertion Generation via Fine-Tuning Retrieval-Augmented Pre-trained Language Models
arxiv-2502-16071.creator: Quanjun Zhang, Chunrong Fang, Yi Zheng, Yaxin Zhang, Yuan Zhao, Rubing Huang, Jianyi Zhou, Yun Yang, Tao Zheng, Zhenyu Chen
arxiv-2502-16071.description: Abstract . Unit testing validates the correctness of the units of the software system under test and serves as the cornerstone in improving software quality and reliability. To reduce manual efforts in writing unit tests, some techniques have been proposed to generate test assertions automatically, including deep learning (DL)-based, retrieval-based, and integration-based ones.

arxiv-2505-03841.title: Contact-Aware Safety in Soft Robots Using High-Order Control Barrier and Lyapunov Functions
arxiv-2505-03841.creator: Kiwan Wong, Maximilian Stölzle, Wei Xiao, Cosimo Della Santina, Daniela Rus, Gioele Zardini
arxiv-2505-03841.description: Abstract Robots operating alongside people, particularly in sensitive scenarios such as aiding the elderly with daily tasks or collaborating with workers in manufacturing, must guarantee safety and cultivate user trust. Continuum soft manipulators promise safety through material compliance, but as designs evolve for greater precision, payload capacity, and speed, and increasingly incorporate rigid elements, their injury risk resurfaces.

arxiv-2505-16436.title: On QFT in Klein space
arxiv-2505-16436.creator: Bin Chen, Zezhou Hu, Xin-cheng Mao
arxiv-2505-16436.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bin Chen, Zezhou Hu, Xin-cheng Mao. In this paper, we investigate the quantum field theory in Klein space that has two time directions. To study the canonical quantization, we select the “length of time” q q as the evolution direction of the system. In our novel construction, some additional modes beyond the plane wave modes are crucial in the canonical quantization and the later derivation of the LSZ reduction formula.

arxiv-2505-19402.title: Recalibrating the Compass: Integrating Large Language Models into Classical Research Methods
arxiv-2505-19402.creator: Tai-Quan Peng Department of Communication Michigan State University East Lansing, MI 48824 Xuzhen Yang Department of Communication Michigan State University East Lansing, MI 48824
arxiv-2505-19402.description: Abstract This paper examines how large language models (LLMs) are transforming core quantitative methods in communication research in particular, and in the social sciences more broadly—namely, content analysis, survey research, and experimental studies. Rather than replacing classical approaches, LLMs introduce new possibilities for coding and interpreting text, simulating dynamic respondents, and generating personalized and interactive stimuli.

arxiv-2506-07639.title: Fast ECoT: Efficient Embodied Chain-of-Thought via Thoughts Reuse
arxiv-2506-07639.creator: Zhekai Duan, Yuan Zhang, Shikai Geng, Gaowen Liu, Joschka Boedecker, Chris Xiaoxuan Lu
arxiv-2506-07639.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhekai Duan, Yuan Zhang, Shikai Geng, Gaowen Liu, Joschka Boedecker, Chris Xiaoxuan Lu. Embodied Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) reasoning enhances vision-language-action (VLA) models by improving performance and interpretability through intermediate reasoning steps. However, its sequential autoregressive token generation introduces significant inference latency, limiting real-time deployment. We propose Fast ECoT, an inference-time acceleration method that exploits the structured and repetitive nature of ECoT to (1) cache and reuse high-level reasoning across timesteps and (2) parallelise the generation of modular reasoning steps.

arxiv-2508-07426.title: Scalable Controllable Accented TTS
arxiv-2508-07426.creator: Henry Li Xinyuan, Zexin Cai, Ashi Garg, Kevin Duh, Leibny Paola García-Perera, Sanjeev Khudanpur, Nicholas Andrews, Matthew Wiesner
arxiv-2508-07426.description: Abstract We propose a method to scale accented TTS training to large, accent-diverse datasets that often lack consistent, high-quality accent labels. Our approach relies on a speech geolocation model to infer accent labels directly from audio. To improve speaker generalization and encourage disentangling speaker from accent we explore timbre augmentation through kNN voice conversion.

arxiv-2511-01592.title: Defining Energy Indicators for Impact Identification on Aerospace Composites: A Physics-Informed Machine Learning Perspective
arxiv-2511-01592.creator: Natália Ribeiro Marinho, Richard Loendersloot, Frank Grooteman, Jan Willem Wiegman, Uraz Odyurt, Tiedo Tinga
arxiv-2511-01592.description: Abstract Energy estimation is critical to impact identification on aerospace composites, where low-velocity impacts can induce internal damage that is undetectable at the surface. Current methodologies for energy prediction are often constrained by data sparsity, signal noise, complex feature interdependencies, non-linear dynamics, massive design spaces, and the ill-posed nature of the inverse problem.

arxiv-2601-00533.description: Abstract All-in-one image restoration aims to recover clean images from diverse unknown degradations using a single model. But extending this task to videos faces unique challenges. Existing approaches primarily focus on frame-wise degradation variation, overlooking the temporal continuity that naturally exists in real-world degradation processes.

arxiv-2601-06881.title: Interfacial standing wave-patterns disentangle dilatational and shear surface viscous effects
arxiv-2601-06881.creator: Debashis Panda, Abdullah M. Abdal, Mosayeb Shams, Lyes Kahouadji, Jalel Chergui, Seungwon Shin, Damir Juric, Omar K. Matar
arxiv-2601-06881.description: Abstract Dilatational and shear surface viscosities are highly correlated parameters, making their individual contributions difficult to disentangle in Stokes flow, linearised flow models, or two-dimensional flows. We therefore investigate the three-dimensional interfacial standing waves as a means to decouple the influence of dilatational and shear surface viscosities.

pmc-11625060.title: Targeting multiple receptor tyrosine kinases with sitravatinib: A Phase 1b study in advanced renal cell carcinoma and castrate-resistant prostate cancer
pmc-11625060.creator: Shubham Pant, Byoung Chul Cho, Christos E. Kyriakopoulos, Alexander Spira, Nizar Tannir, Theresa L. Werner, Xiaohong Yan, Saskia Neuteboom, Richard Chao, Sanjay Goel
pmc-11625060.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Sitravatinib (MGCD516) is an oral inhibitor of several closely related oncogenic tyrosine kinase receptors that include VEGFR-2 (vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-2), AXL, and MET (mesenchymal-epithelial transition). The safety and antitumor activity of sitravatinib are reported in patients from two histologic cohorts (anti-angiogenesis-refractory clear cell renal cell carcinoma [RCC] and castrate-resistant prostate cancer [CRPC] with bone metastases) who participated in a Phase 1/1b study. The patients were enrolled using a 3-stage design that was based on observed objective responses.

pmc-12609919.title: Gene Expression of Feed Intake-Regulating Peptides in the Gut–Brain Axis of Laying Hens Housed Under Two Different Egg Production Systems

pmc-12835525.title: Comparative analysis of OECD guideline data and Tox21 assays to improve reproductive and developmental toxicity prediction
pmc-12835525.creator: Hee Jung Kwon, Hyomin Lee, Sunyi Lee, Woori Ko, Shin Jea Yun, Yoshihiro Uesawa, Joohee Jung
pmc-12835525.description: Reproductive and developmental toxicities pose major challenges in chemical safety evaluation because adverse effects can span generations. Conventional in vivo OECD Test Guideline (TG) assays provide robust hazard characterization but require large animal cohorts and extended study periods. In this study, datasets from OECD TG-compliant studies were compiled to identify the mechanistic drivers of toxicity.

pmc-13162369.description: BackgroundTo the best of our knowledge, this is the first study in oral and maxillofacial radiology to comprehensively include all examination questions, to systematically analyse their topic distribution across years and examination periods, and to concurrently compare multiple contemporary large language models within a unified methodological framework.

pmc-13220087.title: Polypharmacy in Elderly Patients Receiving First-Line Treatment for Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma: Analysis of Potential Drug–Drug Interactions and Outcome

pmc-13306101.title: 岛状背阔肌肌皮瓣与下斜方肌肌皮瓣修复项部皮肤软组织缺损的疗效比较
pmc-13306101.creator: 思拓 周, 怡坤 张, 纪章 曾, 乐 郭, 鹏飞 梁, 明华 张, 捷 周, 鹜远 谭, 丕红 张
pmc-13306101.description: 目的项部皮肤软组织缺损常由电烧伤、肿瘤切除术后、感染或外伤等原因所致。该区域解剖结构复杂，活动度大，且邻近颈椎、大血管及重要神经，缺损修复要求兼顾功能重建与外观满意。岛状背阔肌肌皮瓣因其血供恒定、切取面积大、旋转弧长，被广泛应用于躯干及四肢的重建，尤其是在胸背部及颈项部较大范围缺损的修复中表现出明显优势。下斜方肌肌皮瓣同样具有良好的血供基础，且皮瓣质地适中，蒂部相对平坦，尤其适合修复枕部及上项部纵向分布的创面。但目前未对2种皮瓣在缺损范围、皮瓣大小、供区损伤及术后臃肿程度等方面进行比较，尚不明确不同类型的项部缺损如何进行皮瓣选择。本研究比较2种皮瓣修复项部皮肤软组织缺损的修复面积、并发症、供区植皮需求及术后外形与功能恢复情况，旨在为临床针对不同类型项部缺损选择合适的肌皮瓣提供参考依据。方法回顾性分析中南大学湘雅医院烧伤重建外科2010年1月至2024年12月采用岛状背阔肌肌皮瓣和下斜方肌肌皮瓣进行项部缺损修复的病例资料，包括人口统计学、缺损原因、创面范围、修复皮瓣及其大小、供瓣区植皮情况和手术并发症等。结果6例采用背阔肌肌皮瓣修复项部皮肤软组织缺损的患者，年龄19~65岁，其中男5例，女1例；电烧伤4例，隆突性皮肤纤维肉瘤1例，嗜酸性肉芽肿1例；创面大小16 cm×8 cm~26 cm×14 cm，皮瓣大小28 cm×9 cm~35 cm×15 cm，供瓣区植皮修复4例。5名采用下斜方肌皮瓣进行项部重建的患者，年龄27~74岁，其中男4例，女1例；电烧伤3例，脑膜瘤术后复发侵犯枕项部皮肤软组织2例；创面大小12 cm×6 cm~15 cm×8 cm，皮瓣大小15 cm×7 cm~18 cm×9 cm，供瓣区植皮修复1例。除1例老年患者术后出现低氧血症外，其余患者无明显手术并发症。随访6~15(中位数9)个月，所有患者均成功治愈，颈部活动可，有2例背阔肌肌皮瓣蒂部稍臃肿，其余病例臃肿畸形不明显。结论岛状背阔肌肌皮瓣和下斜方肌肌皮瓣修复项部皮肤软组织缺损各有优缺点，背阔肌肌皮瓣修复面积大，但皮瓣蒂部容易出现臃肿；下斜方肌肌皮瓣修复面积相对较小，但适合修复枕项部纵向创面；针对不同项部皮肤软组织缺损患者选择合适的组织瓣进行修复一般可取得较好的效果。 项部皮肤软组织在头部支撑、头颈运动、颈椎稳定和脊髓保护中起重要作用，但临床工作中偶尔可见烧伤、创伤或肿瘤切除后形成的项部组织缺损创面。该部位解剖比较复杂，深部重要组织结构较多，若不及时修复，可造成严重并发症，甚至导致患者死亡[1-3]。Liu等[4]提出对于项部深度创面，通常首选岛状背阔肌肌皮瓣(latissimus dorsi musculocutaneous flap，LDMF)，次选岛状下斜方肌肌皮瓣(lower trapezius musculocutaneous flap，LTMF)，但有关它们各自的优缺点及其临床个性化选择少见报道。中南大学湘雅医院烧伤重建外科采用个性化选择的岛状LDMF和LTMF进行项部缺损修复多例，获得较好治疗效果，现报告如下。 资料与方法 伦理声明 本研究获得中南大学湘雅医院伦理委员会的批准(审批号：2026060437)。所有参与者均签署了书面知情同意书。本研究遵循《赫尔辛基宣言》的原则。 资料选择 回顾性收集2010年1月至2024年12月中南大学湘雅医院烧伤重建外科收治的11例项部皮肤软组织缺损患者的临床资料。纳入标准：1)项部皮肤软组织缺损，有明确烧伤、创伤史或肿瘤侵犯，清创后或肿瘤切除后创面深达颈后区肌肉层或超过肌肉层。2)采用岛状LDMF和LTMF进行项部缺损修复。3)随访半年以上。排除标准：1)临床资料不完整；2)未配合完成随访。 手术方法 受区创面准备 烧伤创面清创要彻底，间生态的肌腱、神经、骨组织尽量保留，尤其注意肌束“夹心样坏死”和沿枕骨或椎体的“套袖状坏死”，必要时探查主要血管、神经受损情况；清除坏死组织后，反复用双氧水及生理盐水等冲洗。恶性肿瘤彻底根治性切除后用蒸馏水反复冲洗并湿敷创面。 LDMF切取 根据受区肌肉缺损情况、创面范围和方向及点、线、面、弧原则，设计以腋后襞至髂后上棘连线为轴线的LDMF，使其在足够覆盖创面的同时兼顾颈后肌群修复。按设计线在背阔肌前缘切口近端内寻找胸背动、静脉及胸背神经，在背阔肌与前锯肌之间由外向内分离，并尽量保留腰背筋膜以利于肌肉修复。切取过程中严密结扎肋间血管穿支和腰血管分支，直至游离至胸背血管神经束进入背阔肌处，在此处近端离断背阔肌近端以减少蒂部组织量，结扎前锯肌支等胸背血管的分支，仔细分离胸背血管神经束至肩胛下血管分叉处，以此处为旋转点，检查皮瓣血运。一般情况下，胸背动脉的内、外侧支均需包含在肌皮瓣内，若创面窄长也可只切取胸背动脉外侧支营养的肌皮瓣。 LTMF切取 同样依照受区肌肉缺损、创面部位和大小及点、线、面、弧原则，设计切取远端达肩胛下角下方15~17 cm水平的LTMF。切开皮瓣远端，沿斜方肌深面自下向上分离，切断起自胸椎棘突部的斜方肌腱膜，将斜方肌或其腱膜缝合固定于肌皮瓣边缘皮肤，避免分离撕脱。结扎、切断肋间后动脉的肌支和胸椎棘旁穿支，在后正中线和肩胛骨内侧缘之间的中线上保留约3 cm宽的蒂部皮肤和肌肉，窄蒂长度视受区创面位置与大小而定，向上分离找到在肩胛上角内侧从小菱形肌和大菱形肌之间发出的颈横动脉降支并确保其进入蒂部，一般以此为旋转点。如有需要，可适当向近心端分离蒂部血管以增加修复范围，但需注意保留斜方肌的上三分之一以维持肩部稳定。修复同类型缺损，LTMF的手术时间较LDMF略短，出血量较少，但同时也受术中诸多因素(如助手协助熟练度及解剖变异等)影响。 肌皮瓣转移 肌皮瓣切取后以明道或暗道转位至项部创面，确保蒂部血管无受压扭曲、肌皮瓣可无张力覆盖缺损后，将肌瓣与创面边缘肌肉或筋膜组织缝合，并保持肌肉足够张力，然后缝合切口，置放引流。术后包扎和制动固定时，注意勿使蒂部受压扭转。供区尽量直接拉拢缝合，不能直接拉拢缝合者取中厚皮植皮修复并加压包扎。 术后处理 术后常规行抗炎、保温等治疗，颈部制动，患侧背部垫高，手术区适当悬空，并密切观察皮瓣血运和病情变化。适时换药，拔除引流管。后期在康复治疗师指导下有序进行功能锻炼，术后1周开始辅助轻微主动活动，术后第10~14天依据情况拆除伤口缝线后出院，嘱患者术后3~4周有限度行颈部主动运动，逐渐加强。大范围植皮患者同时积极行弹力套加压、外涂药物等抗瘢痕治疗。 术后随访 术后1、3、6、12个月定期随访，观察术区外观和瘢痕情况，指导功能锻炼和抗瘢痕治疗，并进行量表评分。随访6~12个月时，测量头颈部活动度，并进行患者满意度评价。 统计学处理 采用SPSS 17.0统计学软件进行数据分析。采用Shapiro-Wilk法进行正态性检验，Levene检验方差齐性。非正态分布的计量数据以中位数(第1四分位数，第3四分位数)表示，2组比较采用Wilcoxon秩和检验，P<0.

pmc-13385074.title: Preliminary validity evidence for a platform-specific assessment tool for robotic setup and docking
pmc-13385074.creator: T. Shakir, G. Lingam, M. Boal, G. Ryan, W. Ghamrawi, M. Chand, N. Francis
pmc-13385074.description: There is currently no widely available, structured assessment tool with reported validity evidence for robotic system setup and docking. A Delphi consensus-derived checklist for the da Vinci Xi platform has been developed previously. The present study aimed to gather preliminary validity evidence for this checklist using Messick’s unified framework and Kane’s validation inferences.

pmc-13582046.title: Age-Specific Considerations in Bronchiectasis Management: Focus on Older Adults with Emphasis on Anti-inflammatory Treatment
pmc-13582046.creator: Maria Gabriella Matera, Vito De Novellis, Raffaella Pagliaro, Vincenzo Parente, Fabio Perrotta, Mario Cazzola
pmc-13582046.description: Bronchiectasis is increasingly recognized as a chronic inflammatory airway disease involving persistent immune dysregulation, recurrent infection, and progressive lung tissue damage. Older adults bear a particularly high burden of bronchiectasis, as age-related changes such as immunosenescence, multimorbidity, and polypharmacy complicate disease management in this population.

pmc-13595015.title: Induction of ferroptotic and amyloidogenic signatures linked to Alzheimer's disease by chemically distinct air pollutants
pmc-13595015.creator: Kristina Shkirkova, Naomi S. Sta Maria, Herbert Anson, Yashar Aghaei, Mohammad Mahdi Badami, Ararat Chakhoyan, Jose A. Godoy-Lugo, Claire Chung, Salma Durra, Angela Tang-Tan, Lifu Zhao, Alexandra Demetriou, Manuel Morales, Sindhu Daggupati, Isabella Bent, Hyoungjin Park, Caleb Franklin, Selena Chen,
pmc-13595015.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Air pollution (AirP) exposure is associated with increased risk of Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet AirP is chemically heterogeneous, complicating identification of shared pathogenic drivers. We compared acute cortical responses to two chemically distinct but metal-rich AirP sources, diesel exhaust particles (DEP) and World Trade Center (WTC) dust, and contrasted them with woodsmoke (WS), a particulate exposure containing substantially lower metal content.
